description: Pinned six entrances and stopped a seventh, without reading the scene.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Told Sam to breathe before the word, and told you to sit.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Named as still owed eight shillings. Not in the room. Not paid.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Held the eight shillings at Lady Day and said the twenty pound is not yours.
name: John Heminges

description: Named the throat, kept the eight-shilling joke, and heard that you would play.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Answered for the tight doublet and said he would breathe first.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Mentioned the throat once, claimed the first place on a paper, and stopped the nursing.
name: Will Kemp

description: Kept the six entrances, denied the throat once, and stayed on the afternoon bill.
name: William Shakespeare
